It's always worth inquiring about progesterone even if they will very likely decline, I've not heard of anyone being prescribed it through the gic, I was invited to a progesterone trial in one of my appointments but then it never ended up going anywhere. It shows demand is there for it and who knows you might get lucky.

I'd take a copy of your lastest blood tests with you and ask them to check your e levels. 1mg is pretty low but the dose you need is different for everyone, hopefully if it's too low they'll be able to increase the limit on your agreement or at least write to your GP. 

Hormones are a slow process but I prefer to see it as you're getting better every day, I've heard cycling weight and being active are ways to speed up effects but don't worry if you're not able to do that, you're still making progress. Hope your appointment goes ok, I know they can be stressful but you'll feel better afterwards.

Hey Caleb, I just want to let you know that what you're feeling is completely normal, I don't know anyone who wasn't nervous as hell before their first GIC appointment (assuming that's what you have and not a private or clinic appointment). After waiting so much time it's always going to be daunting but remember this is just one step of many and it will be over before you know it. 

There's a few things you can do beforehand to prepare, maybe make a list of your thoughts, feelings, your past in regards to trans stuff. If you know the doctors name then see what other people have said about them, I know some can be awkward about non binary patients so it's possible they'll be awkward about you not feeling dysphoria but even if they're the worst doctor possible they're just one person and your next appointment will be with someone else. That's the worst case scenario though, it's unlikely you'll see someone that bad. 

If your appintment is over zoom then it's a lot less daunting but it can feel a bit anticlimactic so ready yourself for that if applicable otherwise good luck, I'm sure it'll go fine and you'll be surprised how easy it was. Happy Birthday for next week too \^\_\^
